_comment: Per-tag convention RULINGS + anti-examples (notMembers), migrated from the tagging review ledger.
This file is the durable, by-tag home of every adjudicated call — the digest builder inlines each
entry under its tag so taggers see the ruling at the moment they read the definition.
Keys: exact tag id, or a prefix key ending in '*' (applies to every tag id starting with the prefix),
or '_general' (rendered at the top of the digest). build-digest.ts validates every key resolves.
Shape: { rulings: string[], notMembers: [{ card, reason, instead? }] } — 'instead' is the tag that
DOES apply (omit when the answer is 'nothing').

rulings: MYRIAD is intentionally untagged (deckbuilding keyword, like Permanent/Exceptional) — ruled 2026-07-16 during TDE wave 2.

Tony Morgan's BOUNTY economy is intentionally untagged — investigator-specific, not useful for cross-deck search (ruled 2026-07-16). Bounty Contracts' 'Uses (6 bounties)' also gets no uses-starting-* tag.

Bonded SET-ASIDE plumbing ('set it aside, out of play', return-to-set-aside instead of discard) is intentionally untagged — inherent bonded-card behavior; bonded-card + bonded-fetch carry the archetype (ruled 2026-07-16).

A timing WINDOW id must stay neutral even when most members are Forced — timing-forced-leaves-play was renamed timing-when-leaves-play when Tetsuo Mori responded with a [reaction] (2026-07-16; same precedent as timing-when-take-damage).
TimingQualifier conventions: 'at the end of <phase/round/turn>' forced triggers → AtIf; 'when your turn begins' → When; 'would reveal/would advance' pre-windows → Before.

Level variants of the same card may LEGITIMATELY diverge — the higher-level card is intentionally better (Survival Instinct 01581 'disengage' vs 02235 'evade' is a real design difference, ruled 2026-07-03). Never force different-level variants to match; but DO check same-name twins for accidental divergence (values, missing halves) — that was a large bug class.

Self-harm (cost-*-damage/horror-self) is only for VOLUNTARY player-ability cards (asset/event). Treacheries/weaknesses that force horror/damage on you (Doomed, Shell Shock, Nihilism) are NOT self-harm — a 'treachery hurts you' concept has intentionally no tag yet.
A card playing itself from hand on a special trigger (Cryptic Writings) is play-from-hand, NOT recursion — recursion tags need a non-hand zone.
Discovery vs investigation payoff: timing-after-discover-clue fires on clue DISCOVERY including testless; timing-after-successfully-investigate requires a successful investigate TEST by someone.

PLAY ≠ INTO PLAY, generalized corpus-wide (2026-09-05 retro review): a card that lets you PLAY another card 'paying its cost' or 'reducing its cost' is a play (cost-discount / play-area-play-from-other-zone / play-area-play-ignoring-cost), NOT play-area-into-play-from-*. Into-play tags are only for text that puts a card into play bypassing the play action ('put it into play', 'enters play'). Stripped from 27 cards (Old Book of Lore, Joey, Leo Anderson, Dexter, Tommy, Prestidigitation, Ever Vigilant, Motivational Speech, …); searches that then play the card use play-area-play-from-other-zone{zone:'deck'}. A card playing ITSELF on a draw trigger (Cryptic Writings, Winds of Power, Quick Shot) keeps play-area-into-play-from-hand per the 2026-07-03 ruling.

Test-free clue discovery ALWAYS pairs clue-discover-* with testless-clue (2026-09-05): the 2026-07-03 rule was applied to Revised Core only; 15 later cards (Evidence! 60120, Art Student, Grete Wagner, Lucius Galloway, Lesson Learned, …) were brought in line.

Signature investigators and their weaknesses are tagged for EVERY product, including Core/Dunwich (added 2026-09-05), parallel investigators (Advanced/Replacement signatures, Directives, Leading Ladies) and novella promos. Enemy weaknesses stay untagged; treachery weaknesses get their light convention (cost-action-multiple + discard-from-play-self, timing-game-ends, deck-shuffle-player, damage-to-investigator).

COMPOUND ROSTER AUDIT (2026-09-05, whole game tagged): every compound's evaluated roster was read card by card. Removed 10 compounds that were single-tag aliases or strict subsets (enemy-field-control, shroud-reduction, self-harm-cost, healing, exile-package, multiclass-payoff, copies-matter, return-to-hand, failure-prevention, getaway — disengage now lives in Evasion Package); added Willpower Boost, Skill Value Boost (the stat-agnostic '+N skill value' family, split out of Combat/Agility/Intellect Boost) and Testless Damage (split out of Efficient Damage). Over-broad members dropped: deck-shuffle-encounter from Encounter Deck (Persuasion/Hypnotize/Close Call are enemy removal), discard-from-play-self from Discard Self (weakness self-removal is not the discard-for-value archetype), play-area-play-from-other-zone from Into-Play Cheat, the into-play-* trio from Economy, weakness doom on the agenda from Doom Adding (doom-add now carries target). Attack Mitigation and Investigate Payoff were widened instead of deleted. Bold Action (406) and Exhausts (366) are wide by design — mechanical properties the ready/action synergies key on.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (2026-09-05/06, whole game): 31 hostile reviewer agents re-read all 1851 cards against the digest (one ~60-card chunk each, every claim quoted + precedent-cited); 323 findings, 9 chunks also skeptic-verified (91% agreement, so the rest were adjudicated by hand). 366 edits landed across ~300 cards; ~8 findings refuted. Recurring classes, each swept corpus-wide and recorded under its tag: own-Fight/Evade success riders use the during-an-attack/-evade variant; 'would reveal' → Before; 'skill test at your location' and 'enemy at your location' scope tags; cost-discard vs discard-from-play-self; 'last clue' → location-clue-zero; Footwear limit; reducedeffect vs noneliteonly; chaos-symbol-payoff on every symbol bonus; deferred self-exhaust riders; ammo pump; 'After this test ends' → st8{after}. Lint rules rejected two proposals (own-action defeat window on Jenny's Twin .45s, margin rider + success condition on Momentum) — the rules stand.

REQUIRES an explicit cap: either 'Replenish … at the start of each round' (Physical Training / Arcane Studies style) or a printed 'Limit N' line (Ornate Bow 04204). A weapon that merely places a use back on itself with NO written cap is uses-self-place, not replenish.

notMembers.reason: self-refund on a miss, no written cap
self-refund on a miss, no written cap

rulings: The card places a use-token on ITSELF (.18 Derringer, Chainsaw, Ornate Bow). Distinct from uses-support (places on OTHER cards) and uses-replenish (capped auto/triggered refill). An 'on fail' condition is carried by the card's skill-test-condition-fail, not by this tag.

conditional: true when the placement is gated on a trigger/symbol (Luke Robinson's elder sign, Twila's reaction) rather than a plain play/action effect (Extra Ammunition, Recharge) — mirrors uses-self-place's flag (Empty Vessel). Ruled 2026-07-16 for Luke/Empty Vessel consistency.
Printed starting pool ('Uses (X …)') only. Investigators have no printed use pool — never tag one from an ability that merely interacts with charges.
Newer kinds exist: try / key / lock; optional perInvestigator flag for 'X per investigator' pools.
Grow a counter on the card from empty. Card-local tokens are NOT your resource pool — this tag was dropped from the Big Money compound for exactly that confusion.

A REPEATABLE spend-resource boost (Streetwise, Higher Education, Dig Deep) = stats-mod-pump-resource PLUS the boost tag with value:"dynamic". valuePerPump = the boost of ONE activation (Fire Axe 1res→+2 ⇒ 2; Streetwise 2res→+3 ⇒ 3).
EXHAUST-gated boosts are NOT repeatable — no pump tag; keep the flat boost value (High Roller 04156 stays value:2).

One pump tag per card even when a conditional doubles the boost ('+1, +2 instead if this is an evasion or parley'): valuePerPump is the base rate (Silver Tongue/Endurance/Spiritual Intuition = 1); Sharp Rhetoric and Levelheaded were carrying a second {valuePerPump:2} and were trimmed (2026-09-05).

stats-mod-pump-ammo exists since 2026-09-05 (adversarial review): M1918 BAR and Gatling Gun spend AMMO per pump and were carrying stats-mod-pump-charge; the pump family follows the cost family's ammo ≠ charge rule.

Additive base + conditional bonus with EQUAL increments ('+1; +1 more if …' / 'spend a charge to empower') = ONE tag at the CEILING value plus the condition/cost tags — never two identical tags (Enchanted Blade 05118 = value:2).
'N, or M instead if …' REPLACEMENT = two tags with the DIFFERENT values (value:1 AND value:2 — Deduction, Fearless, Vicious Blow shape).
Passive = genuinely always-on while in play. A boost that EXPIRES (asset discards at end of round, 'until end of turn') is lasting/duration, not passive (Intrepid was mistagged passive).
Use the optional action arg to discriminate multiple base-set abilities on one card (Duke: combat-4 for Fight vs intellect-4 for Investigate must differ by action, not be two identical tags).

A PERSISTENT 'when/after you defeat an enemy' window only. A rider on the card's OWN attack ('Fight. If this attack defeats…') does NOT get this tag — the card's own success is skill-test-condition-successful territory (Meat Cleaver, Timeworn Brand, Coup de Grâce, Enchanted Blade(3), Detective's Colt 05009 all stripped).

PERSISTENT reaction firing after ANY investigation (Dr. Milan Christopher, Scavenging, Vault of Knowledge). A card's own 'Investigate. If you succeed, …' uses skill-test-condition-successful, NOT this tag (Deduction, Pilfer, Winging It, Seeking Answers, Clairvoyance were all de-tagged).
Fires on clue DISCOVERY including testless discovery (Alice Luxley 05151, Hawk-Eye Camera 05154) — broader than timing-after-successfully-investigate.
The heal-payoff archetype window (Carolyn Fern 05001, Hypnotic Therapy 05007).
trait is OPTIONAL; optional cardType ("event"|"asset"|"skill") covers 'after you play an event' (Wendy's Amulet 01514 {cardType:"event"}, Double Double 05320).
A timing WINDOW is neutral — never bake 'forced' into it just because one member responds with a Forced ability (Sophie). How the card responds (Fast event / [reaction] / Forced) is a separate axis.
Margin-only riders ('succeed by N or more', 'fail by N or less') get skill-value-* ONLY — never skill-test-condition-successful/fail alongside. The margin already implies the result.
Skill cards do not use timing tags; their 'if this test succeeds/fails' effects use these tags.

Conditional-upgrade values tag BOTH numbers: 'draw 1 (2 instead if you succeed by 2+)' → deck-draw-you value:1 AND value:2 (Perception 60228, Guts 60424, Overpower 60126, Manual Dexterity 60325 all fixed to match Deduction/Fearless/Vicious Blow).

Composure-style SELF-soak routing text ('…before it can be assigned to your investigator', card soaks its controller's damage) is NOT tanking — tank tags mean protecting OTHERS (removed from 03107/03109/03111/03115/05236).

Retribution ('You take all damage and horror from this attack') is redirect-damage-horror, not redirect-attack: the attack still resolves against the other investigator, only its damage/horror lands on you (moved 2026-09-06). redirect-attack needs 'resolve its attack against you instead' (Heroic Rescue).
Only when the card MECHANICALLY supports trait X: boosts/refills/cares about OTHER cards of that trait. Merely HAVING the trait is not support.
A trait-restricted extra slot does NOT also get trait-support-X — the AdditionalSlot compound already arg-matches the slot (Bandolier, Arcane Enlightenment stripped).

REQUIRES a real printed trait (Monster, Humanoid, …). 'Weakness' and 'Elite' are card classifications, NOT traits: non-weakness → enemy-nonweakness; Elite conditions → enemy-elite-* tags. Never emit this tag with no trait arg.
'non-weakness enemy' conditions (Close Call 01583, Persuasion 04105).

The Monster Slayer shape: effect only works 'against a NON-Elite enemy'. Do not confuse with enemy-elite-reducedeffect (the Persuasion 'if Elite, <lesser effect> instead' shape) — Tennessee Sour Mash 05191 had wrongly copied Persuasion's pair.

The card CAUSES engagement as an effect (Taunt, 'Get over here!', Heroic Rescue, On the Hunt — the 9 force-engagers). NOT for conditions on an already-engaged enemy, and NOT the basic [Engage] action.

notMembers.reason: conditions on an enemy engaged with ANOTHER investigator; causes no engagement

rulings: FORCE an enemy to engage you, only (Taunt, Heroic Rescue, On the Hunt). Targeting/conditions on an enemy ALREADY engaged with you → enemy-engage-target-engaged (the 2026-07-03 split).
Targets or conditions on an enemy engaged with you (Oops! 02113/60518, Fire Extinguisher 02114, Flamethrower 04305, Mano a Mano, Necronomicon 60233, Trench Knife).

An investigator/enemy located AT a connecting location — a targeting SCOPE only (Jim's Trumpet; 'Get over here!', Telescopic Sight, Decoy, Marksmanship). MOVING TO a connecting location is a normal location-move-* effect, never this tag (Shortcut, Pathfinder, Think on Your Feet were all stripped).

BENEFICIAL placement from the token bank onto a location. Placing one of your OWN clues as a reaction COST is cost-reaction-spend-clue — Dr. Maleson 02302 is the canonical (and once-reversed) case; final ruling: Maleson = cost-reaction-spend-clue.
Includes 'place 1 of your clues on your location' as a reaction cost (Dr. William T. Maleson 02302) — you lose the clue; where it goes doesn't change that it's a cost.

Cancels the DRAWING of an encounter card itself (Dr. Maleson). Cancelling a drawn card's EFFECTS → cancel-encounter-effect (Ward of Protection 02307, Dark Insight 05014). REPLACING the draw with something else ('Instead, search…' — On the Hunt 03263) is not a cancel at all. Discarding an in-play treachery → discard-treachery-in-play.
Means 'MOVE a looked-at card to the bottom of the deck' (Alyssa Graham, Scroll of Secrets) — it never meant 'look at the bottom'. Renamed from deck-look-bottom for exactly this trap.

Charges (spells/charged relics) ONLY since the 2026-07-03 split. A firearm spending AMMO is cost-action-spend-ammo — 28 guns were once embarrassingly tagged as spending charges. Match the printed use-token type: ammo/charge/supply/secret/resource are all distinct tags.
In-game card draw only. Opening-hand manipulation (Sefina's 13-card reveal) is NOT draw.
Conditional-upgrade draw ('draw 1, or 2 instead') → both values (see skill-test-condition rulings).

notMembers.reason: looks at + takes specific cards — a search, not a draw

rulings: NAME TRAP: despite the deck- prefix (the group folder), deck-discard-card-choose/-random mean discarding from your HAND (choose vs random — Mists of R'lyeh / Obsessive, Liquid Courage). Milling the player deck is deck-discard-deck. (An earlier ruling here had this backwards and cost a calibration miss — corrected 2026-07-13.)
Searching your DECK (or discard, via deck-search-discard). Searching the COLLECTION/outside the game is not a deck search (Dark Pact fetching its Price is collection-search — untagged).

'Search' is a MECHANICAL term (looking through hidden cards) — apply deck-search-* ONLY when the text literally searches. Choosing a card from the OPEN discard pile ('Choose a card in your discard pile' — Scrounge for Supplies, A Chance Encounter, Resourceful) is NOT a search; discard-pile-to-* carries it (ruled 2026-07-17, full-TDE review; 4 cards stripped).

The FOUND card's own trigger ('when you search your deck and X is among the searched cards' — TDE Research archetype: Occult Evidence 06008, Astounding Revelation 06023, Surprising Find 06278). The searcher-side window is timing-when-search-deck (Mandy). Mandy's search-widening effect ('search 3 additional cards or resolve 1 additional target') deliberately has NO tag yet.
Copies sharing ONE slot (Empower Self trio, copies:3). Not slot-additional (extra slot) and not slot-convert (type change).
Ignore a forced 'use X instead of Y' substitution (Empower Self trio); stat arg = the protected stat. The inverse of stats-mod-use-instead.

Committed-skill bonus gated on a BASIC action's test (Brute Force fight, Sharp Vision investigate, Expeditious Retreat evade). Cards reacting to PERFORMING basic actions in general (Close the Circle, EotE) are a DIFFERENT mechanic — new tag when that pack lands (ruled 2026-07-16).

Asset control moving between investigators: give (Teamwork 02018, Solemn Vow 06020 played under another's control) or take (Kleptomania 06036). Resource transfers = gain-resource-move-investigator (both on Teamwork/Kleptomania). Moving DAMAGE/HORROR between player cards (Solemn Vow's second ability, Tommy Muldoon) still has NO tag.
Play an event as if at another location (Luke Robinson 06004). Becomes common in Chapter 2 (Miguel de la Cruz) — per user 2026-07-16.
Bank an ENCOUNTER card into the victory display (The Eye of Truth 06325). Future member: Blood of K'n-yan (TDC) — per user 2026-07-16.
An enemy gains ALERT (Daring 06111, paired with gain-retaliate like Knuckleduster). Future member: String Along (TDC) — per user 2026-07-16.

Play a card WITHOUT paying its resource cost ('its resource cost is considered paid' — Shining Trapezohedron 06329). Mechanically distinct from cost-discount (user ruling 2026-07-16) but an Economy compound member. Ability-cost waivers → action-activate-ignoring-cost.
Also covers RE-resolving an ability without paying its [action] cost (Abigail Foreman 06324 replaying a Tome ability — retagged off recursion-replay, whose members replay event CARDS, not abilities).

The bonded card itself, living set aside outside the deck (Soothing Melody 05314, Blood-Rite 05317, Wish Eater). The OWNER side that fetches bonded cards = bonded-fetch. Both were deck-* prefixed until 2026-07-16 — regrouped because bonded cards are NOT deck contents (Guardian review).
Fetch from the SET-ASIDE bonded pool (Gate Box, Dream Diary, Empty Vessel). NOT a deck search: no range arg, and deliberately NOT a Search-compound member (ruled 2026-07-16).

Relocating EXISTING damage/horror between player cards. scope 'cross-investigator' (Solemn Vow — protective, joins ProtectorTank/Support via where-filter; future members: Devil (FHV), Lucky Charm (Core 2026)) vs scope 'self' (Tommy Muldoon's elder sign — own-board bookkeeping, joins neither). Not tank-redirect-* (incoming damage) and not heal-* (removal). Ruled 2026-07-16 after the Guardian review caught Solemn Vow with its main benefit untagged.

Another investigator resolves an encounter card you would have ('You handle this one!' 04028 — whose main feature was untagged until this review; First Watch's distribution). Taking another's card onto YOURSELF is tank-redirect-encounter ('Let me handle this!'; First Watch carries both directions).

Commit restricted to / gated on ATTACK tests — any attack, not just the basic Fight action (Daring; contrast commit-during-basic-action). Marks a skill as attack support; commit-during-evade is the evasion twin (Daring carries both).
BONUS on revealing a symbol token (Song of the Dead) — the positive counterpart of chaos-downside; Shrivelling/Blinding Light-style penalties are chaos-downside instead.

Applied to EVERY bonus keyed to a specific symbol reveal, not only damage: ready (Jacob Morrison), return-to-hand (Fey), clue (Control Variable, Keeper of the Key), enemy debuff (Wither, Banish), remote investigate (Sixth Sense), auto-success (Beloved), doom removal (Dread Curse of Azathoth), enemy self-damage on a manual reveal (Hypnotic Gaze ×3, Voice of Ra) — added 2026-09-06.
STAT-DERIVED: printed health ≥ 2 → soak-health value:<health>; sanity ≥ 2 → soak-sanity value:<sanity>.

'Deal/place X damage/horror to IT/THIS/HER' (onto the asset itself) is SOAK routing, NOT a self-harm cost — never double-tag with cost-*-damage/horror-self (Aquinnah 01582/01691, Grete Wagner 60107/60128, Beat Cop(2) 01528).

Needs a CONCRETE loss on a bad symbol (lose actions, take horror, break the card, lose resources). A 'nothing happens' gamble (Henry Wan) stays out — chaos-reveal-manual already covers the reveal mechanic.
chaos-downside-action value is OPTIONAL ('lose all remaining actions' = no value). chaos-downside-discard covers self-break, hand-discard, and controlled-asset-discard shapes.
Manual-reveal gambles WITH a real loss (Astral Travel, Recharge) DO carry their downside tag.
Heuristics beat agents here: an agent sweep once found ZERO of these; a word-heuristic found 8. Trust the lint flag.

AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, FHV ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): the 'Double' keyword — spend an action as an additional cost to PLAY (11 FHV members). A play cost, distinct from the icon-scoped ability spend-cost families.

AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, FHV): completes the enemy-value family (fight/evade/horror/damage → +health) — references an enemy's PRINTED health as a value (Ancestral Token, Blackmail File). Distinct from enemy-value-remaining-health (current damage) and enemy-value-health-reduction (shrinks it).

AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, TSK ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): marks the 17 Scarlet Keys customizable cards (upgrade-sheet system). Only base text tagged mechanically. Meta-designation like Myriad — keep for a browsable upgradeable class, or drop.
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, EOTE ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): use-tokens moved onto BOARD entities as markers for remote effects (Archive of Conduits gates, Occult Reliquary; 5 members).

AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, EOTE ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): card-local resources pay for trait-X cards (the EOTE wallet family: Prophetic/Sleuth/Bruiser/Crafty/Antiquary/Schoffner's; traits arg lists what it pays for). trait-support-* enum extended with Fortune/Charm/Armor/Tool/Creature for these; Favor/Ritual/Tactic-wallet halves use existing members where available.

AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, EOTE ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): the injury/panic weakness family healable as damage/horror (4 members). Their action-type-lockout clauses stay untagged per the behavior-restriction convention (Promise, Self-Centered).
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, TIC ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): revealed bless/curse returns to the BAG instead of the token pool (the Innsmouth conservation mechanic; 5 TIC members).
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, TIC ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): sealed tokens used as a RESOURCE — released/spent as costs or consumed by effects (4 TIC members).
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, TIC ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): gates/scales on the number of bless/curse in the bag (Favor family, 3 TIC members).
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17, TIC ingestion — REVIEW WELCOME): gates/scales on committed-card count — the Silas/Amanda skills-matter archetype (3 TIC members).
AUTONOMOUS TAG (2026-07-17): systematic extension of the closed spend-cost family for offering tokens (Jacob Morrison).
Reveal-and-hope gambles (Hypnotic Gaze, Astral Travel, Recharge, Voice of Ra). This is NOT token control — it was dropped from the Chaos Token Control compound.

A manual reveal is NOT a skill-test step: do not pair with timing-skill-st3-reveal-chaos-token unless the card ALSO interacts with in-test reveals (Premonition substitutes into real reveal windows and keeps it; the pure gambles were stripped 2026-07-13).

ST.3 of a SKILL TEST ('the investigator performing the skill test reveals one chaos token'). A card that manually reveals tokens outside a test (chaos-reveal-manual gambles) does NOT get this timing tag (ruled 2026-07-13; 7 cards stripped).

'When you would reveal a chaos token' / 'When a chaos token would be revealed' → timing Before, per the general qualifier convention (swept 2026-09-05: The Codex of Ages, Olive McBride ×2, Premonition 04199, Katarina Sojka).

STAT-DERIVED: cardType ∈ {asset,event} AND level === 0 AND max(count of ONE skill's icons) + wild ≥ 2. Two DIFFERENT icons (willpower+combat) do NOT qualify (Taunt, Physical Training were over-tagged by the old icons.length rule). Use rederive-icons-scoped.ts — derive-stat-tags-all.ts still has the old buggy rules.
STAT-DERIVED: cardType ∈ {asset,event} AND level === 0 EXACTLY AND icons include wild. A card with UNDEFINED level (Search for the Truth) is NOT level 0.

Core 2026 reprints of Guts/Manual Dexterity/Overpower/Perception (12090–12093) say 'the performing investigator draws 1 card' → deck-draw-investigator + commit-benefits-performer (Support), unlike their Core originals which say 'draw 1 card' (deck-draw-you). A legit twin divergence (2026-09-05 text-drift pass).
The card ATTACHES to something. HOSTING attachments is not attaching — Dayana Esperence receives Spells but attaches nothing (removed; no 'receives-attachment' tag exists, deliberately).
Recursion = playing/retrieving from a non-hand zone (discard, deck, exile). A card played normally from HAND — even on a special trigger like 'when you draw it' (Cryptic Writings) — is not recursion.
PAIRS WITH clue-discover-* when the discovery is test-free — the discover tag says where, testless-clue says how. Don't drop one for the other.

Discounts OTHER cards (Fence, Chuck Fergus, Ever Vigilant) — the Economy sense. A card reducing only its OWN cost (Extensive Research offsetting its printed 10) is cost-discount-self and NOT economy ('you have been tricked' — ruled 2026-07-17).

'Take an action as if it were your turn' / Haste's repeat = an IMMEDIATE out-of-sequence action (Quick Thinking, Swift Reflexes, Haste, The Stars Are Right), distinct from action-additional (a bigger action pool — Leo De Luca). Both are Extra Actions compound members (ruled 2026-07-17).

Renamed from condition-own-copies (2026-07-17): also covers fetching duplicates of a CHOSEN card (Lucid Dreaming, of:'chosen'). zone = where copies are counted. All members roll into the Copies Matter compound. Myriad itself stays untagged — this tag is for copies-referencing EFFECTS.

Damage already ON an enemy / remaining health: finisher gates (Garrote Wire, comparison exact 1) and scaling payoffs (Followed, args omitted). Not enemy-value-health-reduction (which shrinks printed health — Wither(4)).

A card occupies NO slot it normally would (Abigail Foreman's attached Tome). Future member: Trigger Man (TSK). Rolls into Slot Tech with slot-convert/slot-share; it is NOT slot-additional (Abigail grants no slot — mistagged in wave 1, caught by user review).

For cards ENTERING PLAY out-of-band (assets cheated in — Ever Vigilant, Sleight of Hand). EVENTS just PLAY — 'play another Easy Mark at no cost' is play-area-play-ignoring-cost, not into-play (events are never 'put into play'). A self-committing skill's 'put it into play' bookkeeping (Surprising Find) is also NOT this tag (ruled 2026-07-17).

Default = pool resources. When the resources are USES printed on the card (Gregory Gry's Uses (9 resources)), set source:'card'; pool-or-card costs (Physical Training family, on the cost-free twin) may use source:'either'.

Generic 'after you draw a card' reaction windows (Dream-Enhancing Serum's duplicate trigger). NOT for drawing ITSELF (Cryptic Writings = play-from-hand trigger) and NOT encounter draws ('You handle this one!' = encounter-offload).
Ignore your location's effects/keywords during an action (Read the Signs). Future member: Mesmeric Influence (FHV) — per user 2026-07-17.
Creates map connections (Open Gate pairs) — a Mobility compound member (ruled 2026-07-17: Open Gate's main function was untagged).

attacking-enemy vs engaged-enemy: when the card responds to an ATTACK and damages that attacker, it is testless-damage-attacking-enemy even if the card also engages the enemy first (Heroic Rescue 03106 — 'resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage'; also Hypnotic Gaze). engaged-enemy is for damaging an enemy engaged with you OUTSIDE an attack context (Taunt(3) 60130).

Includes a DEFERRED/CONDITIONAL self-exhaust written inside the [reaction] effect, not only exhaust-before-the-colon: Recall the Future 04158 exhausts only if its named token is revealed, and still carries this cost tag — the exhaust gates the ability either way.

'After this test ends' riders get this window with timing:after — even on a SKILL card (Prescient 60419). The 'skill cards use skill-test-condition-*, not timing tags' convention covers success/fail conditions only; an explicit step-boundary reference like 'after this test ends' is still this timing tag.

A pure targeting SCOPE, beneficial or harmful: Dark Pact 04038 'deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location' carries location-your-investigator despite being a weakness's self-inflicted harm. Don't drop scope tags because the effect is negative.
'Enemies cannot attack YOU' is a BUFF on you, not an enemy debuff (same for buff-cannot-engage-you — moved out of the enemy group for this reason).
Investigator counterpart of buff-asset-* (Five of Pentacles 05039, Hawk-Eye Camera 05154 sanity).
Optional action arg scopes the reduction (Fine Clothes = {action:"parley"}).
Signature '<Investigator> deck only.' cards — 23 were once missing it; the scaffold/lint should catch the 'deck only' line.
The card defeats YOUR OWN investigator as an effect/cost ('I'll see you in hell!', Ghastly Revelation).
'Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator' gets limit-in-play{trait:'Mask',count:1} on every Mask (2026-09-05 — Fox Mask had it, the other five FHV Masks did not).

'Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator' is limit-in-play{trait:'Footwear',count:1} exactly like the Masks (Track Shoes, Hiking Boots added 2026-09-05). 'Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck' is a deckbuilding limit and stays untagged.
Targets an asset/investigator YOU CONTROL as scope (Moonlight Ritual).
Phase-manipulation EFFECTS (skip/repeat a phase) — Gold Pocket Watch. Future members: Deliverance, Ultimate Sacrifice. Distinct from timing-phase-* which are timing POINTS.
Between-scenario deckbuilding swaps (Adaptable). Future members: Arcane Research, Down the Rabbit Hole.
Reduces an enemy's printed health (Wither(4) 05321).
Variable amounts use value:"dynamic" (the old dynamic?:boolean flag is retired). Conditional-upgrade gains tag both values (Cryptic Writings 3 AND 4).
Skip on boring weaknesses — investigators and basic/story weaknesses get few or no tags; only genuine player-facing effects.

Compound note: Big Money membership is where-filtered to {comparison:"min"} — a 'max 0' (empty pool) condition is the OPPOSITE of big (Madame Labranche lesson; same for condition-hand-size / Big Hand).

Split 2026-09-05: damage-redirect-attack = an ENEMY's attack damage lands on another enemy instead of you (Aquinnah ×3) → Attack Mitigation + Efficient Damage. Your OWN attack's damage moved to a different enemy (Oops! ×3, .45 Thompson (5)) is damage-redirect-own-attack → Efficient Damage only.

A success rider on the card's OWN bold Fight / Evade uses skill-test-condition-successful-during-an-attack / -during-an-evade; the plain tag is for every other test (investigate, parley, a generic test, or a boost that applies to fights AND investigations like Ice Pick). Never both variants on one clause (2026-09-05 adversarial review: Bind Monster, Stealth ×2, Handcuffs ×2, Ethereal Form ×2, Bolas, Quick Getaway, Transmogrify → evade variant; Tennessee Sour Mash, Enchanted Blade (3), Cyclopean Hammer → attack variant; the redundant plain tag was dropped from Blinding Light ×2 and Fire Extinguisher).

NOT applied when the only self-discard is the cost of a triggered ability — cost-*-discard-self already carries it (Police Badge, St. Hubert's Key, The Codex of Ages, Relentless, Disc of Itzamna, Mysterious Raven trimmed 2026-09-05). Keep it when a SEPARATE clause discards the card (Delay the Inevitable's Forced upkeep tax, Backpack's 'if there are no cards attached, discard it').

A Forced 'at the end of the round: Discard X' is timing-phase-upkeep-ends{at/if} + discard-from-play-self, not a duration (Colt Vest Pocket, Intrepid, Lure L1 convention; Lure L2's duration tag trimmed 2026-09-05).

'during a skill test at your location' / 'a chaos token revealed at your location' triggers carry the scope even when the card is a Fast event (swept 2026-09-05: Darrell Simmons, Book of Living Myths, Ofuda, Miracle Wish, Seal of the Elders, Keeper of the Key, Dawn Star).
'Deal N damage to an enemy at your location' always pairs testless-damage-your-location with location-your-enemy (swept 2026-09-05: Coup de Grâce, Blood-Rite, Dr. Charles West III, Quick Shot).

'After the last clue is discovered at/from your location' pairs timing-after-discover-clue with location-clue-zero (swept 2026-09-05: Hawk-Eye Folding Camera, Hiking Boots, Dowsing Rod (4), Misdirection, Lost Arcana, Monterey Jack).

'+1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]])' (Spectral Razor ×2) and 'up to 2 damage instead if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]]' (Drain Essence) are reducedeffect: the effect still works on an Elite, just less. noneliteonly is only for effects that do NOTHING against an Elite (Monster Slayer, Ofuda).

A DEFERRED/OPTIONAL self-exhaust written inside an [action] ability's effect ('If you succeed, you may exhaust X to …') still gates the rider and carries the tag, like the reaction ruling: Trusty Bullwhip ×2, Butterfly Swords (2), Prismatic Spectacles, Dowsing Rod (0), Machete 12020 added 2026-09-06 (Sledgehammer, Katana, Blessed Blade precedent).

Weakness punishment that scales per point failed by (Lethal Curiosity, Failed Experiment) stays UNTAGGED — the fail-forward archetype must hold only player payoffs (Lethal Curiosity's tag removed 2026-09-06; test-initiate-* on the weakness test is kept).
